description: Figure 5 is a bar chart that illustrates the performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search. The chart has two sets of bars, one representing strong supervision and the other representing weak supervision. The x-axis of the chart lists three different models: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The y-axis represents the performance gain in percentage, ranging from 0% to 30%. The bars for strong supervision are solid, while the bars for weak supervision are striped. The GPT-4o model shows the highest performance gain with strong supervision, followed by Qwen2-72B-VL and Claude-3.5-sonnet. The performance gain is calculated by comparing the performance of VisuoThink with and without rollout search.
